outcome: Labor type (vaginal delivery or cesarean section)
cohort: 165 healthy Turkish females aged between 18 and 45 years
finding: There was a significant difference in pelvic diameters and brim index measurements according to pelvic types.
mod_finding: The android type pelvis was found to be less suitable for natural labor, and only 7 females who delivered via cesarean had a gynecoid pelvic type.
